description: The file is a Perl module 'Git::SVN::Utils' containing utility functions for handling paths, URLs, and other common operations used across the Git::SVN project.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Displays an error message to STDERR and exits with code 1.

methods.name: can_compress
methods.description: Checks if the Compress::Zlib module is available for compression functionalities.

methods.name: canonicalize_path
methods.description: Converts a file path into a canonical form suitable for SVN API, using SVN::Core if available or falling back to a custom implementation.

methods.name: canonicalize_url
methods.description: Converts a URL into a canonical form safe for SVN API, using SVN::Core if available or falling back to a custom implementation.

methods.name: join_paths
methods.description: Joins multiple path segments into one canonical path, handling slashes correctly.

methods.name: add_path_to_url
methods.description: Appends a path segment onto a URL, ensuring proper escaping and formatting.
